blocks.x: Collider's Perri Nemiroff chats with the cast and creatives of American Hostage at TIFF 2026.
Giovanni Ribisi, Kristoffer Polaha, Mireille Enos, and William Jackson Harper discuss their scene partners, histories with co-stars, and Enos teases For All Mankind Season 6.
Adam Arkin, Nina Lopez-Corrado, Jonathan Tucker, and Kat Cunning discuss the two directors' visions and collaborating on the series and the stars discuss relationships with their co-stars.

Before its MGM+ debut, Jon Hamm’s (Mad Men) new thriller series, American Hostage, celebrated its world premiere at this year’s Toronto International Film Festival. Based on the 2022 eight-episode podcast of the same name, the show tells the harrowing true story of Tony Kiritsis, portrayed by Giovanni Ribisi (Avatar: Fire and Ash), from the perspective of Indianapolis local radio reporter Fred Heckman (Hamm), whom Kiritsis trusted most with his story.

From creators Shawn Ryan and Eileen Myers (The Night Agent), American Hostage is the first season of a new anthology series, beginning with this 1977 crime that captured the public’s attention in a way that was unheard of at the time. Before live coverage, and just at the precipice of the 24-hour news cycle, a desperate man’s hostage scheme and stand-off with police is broadcast live on air when Kiritsis demands a phone call with Heckman.

At the Collider Media Studio, presented by Campari and The Cayman Islands, Perri Nemiroff had the opportunity to chat with the team behind the show ahead of its two-episode premiere on September 20. Check out the full conversations in the videos below, with time codes provided.
The 'American Hostage' Cast Reveals How They Pulled Off the Show's Intense Live-Action Setup
"We were doing eight to 11 pages a day, live."

In this interview, Nemiroff speaks with Ribisi, Kristoffer Polaha (Jurassic World Dominion), who portrays Dick Hall, the broker Kiritsis takes hostage, Mireille Enos (For All Mankind), who will play Barbara Heckman, Fred’s wife, and William Jackson Harper (The Morning Show), who portrays Heckman’s protégé, Ben Hairston. At TIFF, they spotlight their scene partners’ performances and collaborations on set, discuss past histories with co-stars, and Enos reveals how For All Mankind Season 6 “sticks the landing.”

How 'American Hostage's Directing Duo Created Its Raw, Immersive Visual Style
"Especially as a television director, that's something that doesn't happen often."

In this conversation, Nemiroff sits down with directors Adam Arkin (The Night Agent) and Nina Lopez-Corrado (House of the Dragon), and stars Jonathan Tucker (Westworld), who portrays FBI Special Agent Cormac McNally, and Kat Cunning (Rap Sh!t), who portrays Ibby Hall. During their conversation, the directing duo discuss why American Hostage benefits from two visual languages and creatives at the helm, and the team highlight their top-notch camera crew and discuss their relationships with their scene partners.

American Hostage Season 1, Episodes 1 and 2, are available to stream on MGM+.
Abby St. Clair, Eileen Myers, Shawn Ryan
